text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—I wonder if a Triple Crown Umamusume
will emerge this year?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Man, who knows!
The one to watch in my book is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Satsuki Sho had finally arrived.
Being the first leg of the Classic Triple Crown,
the spectators' expectations were sky-high. However—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, come to think of it...
This Smart Falcon girl specializes in dirt races, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I wonder why she came out?
Is she going to be all right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Maybe she can handle turf... too? Winning Lives look fun, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —I see. I guess everyone's surprised after all~.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah~. I knew that already.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "Falco was a super high-profile rookie Umadol on the dirt, but..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Over here, I'm practically an unknown Umamusume.
It's only natural for people to wonder, "Who's that?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Still, that's fine for everyone else!
Because Falco believes in Falco.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I'm super anxious, but...
I have to believe that Falco can do it."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've made it this far,
all that's left is to seize the center position!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to show all our fans
Falco singing on a grand stage...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes waver, if only for the briefest moment.
Yet, as she believes in herself and takes on the challenge—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha, that's right.
It wasn't just Falco.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the call-out!
Falco, heading out! ☆
